description: src/client.rs:549 — `resp.method_responses.iter().find(|inv| inv.2 == call_id)` returns the first invocation matching call_id. RFC 8620 §3.6 allows a single method call to produce multiple invocations in the response (e.g. one Foo/get followed by an error invocation, or a back-reference resolution that produces multiple results). If a server returns both a success response AND an `error` invocation with the same call_id, the success is returned and the error is silently dropped. Trigger condition: server emits [(Foo/get, {...}, r1), (error, {type:serverFail}, r1)] — caller gets the success response and never sees the error. Filed as bug, not chore: a real protocol-conformant server pattern produces this shape.
title: extract_response returns first match; multiple invocations sharing call_id are not handled
